x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change motions-submission-window (REQ-SUBW-001 to REQ-SUBW-003, matrix row mot-18). A meeting already carried submissionDeadline; it now also carries the moment submission opens, so motions and amendments have a window like questions do.

submissionOpensAt.title: Submission opens
submissionOpensAt.description: When members can start submitting motions and amendments for this meeting. Empty means submission is open from the moment the meeting exists.
submissionOpensAt.x-notes: Enforced by SubmissionDeadlineListener: a motion or amendment created before this moment is refused with a message naming it, and a meeting whose opening is not before its submissionDeadline cannot be saved.
